newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche sees 96/97 sales at 3.5 bln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Porsche sees 96/97 sales at 3.5 bln dmk.

text.p: Dr. Ing.h.c.F. Porsche AG will see group sales climb to around 3.5 billion marks ($2.1 billion) in the current business year from 2.81 billion marks the year before, the company said in a letter to shareholders.
The letter said unit sales during the year ending July 31 should climb to more than 30,000 units, up from 19,262 units last year.
Porsche announced earlier this morning that net profit in the first half of this year climbed to 38.4 million marks from 10.3 million marks on sales of 1.78 billion marks.
